name: plan_user_requirement_bigmodel
description: 使用大模型一次性生成并落地全局计划蓝图，覆盖阶段划分、节点依赖、风险提示与执行闭环触发。适用于用户首次提出复杂任务时的总规划入口。
inputSchema: {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"sessionId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"稳定会话ID，建议使用JWT jti；若未提供将由服务端兜底"},"userGoal":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"用户目标，建议包含期望结果、范围与约束"}},"required":["sessionId","userGoal"]}
outputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string","description":"执行状态：success/error"},"planId":{"type":"string","description":"计划ID"},"message":{"type":"string","description":"结果说明"},"phaseResult":{"type":"object","description":"阶段执行结果"},"reportResult":{"type":"object","description":"报告生成结果"}}}
thoughtChain: 理解用户目标并生成可执行MVP蓝图
持久化蓝图并初始化最小节点
记录审计并推送计划创建事件
